S6-BUG-01 CLAIMANT-12: intake session locale is fixed at start, so server validation messages (validateAnswer) stay in the start language after the claimant switches language. Please add PATCH /intake/sessions/{id} {locale} (or honour Accept-Language per request) in src/modules/intake/routes.js+service.js; claimant client already re-localizes fraud notices from config.branding.fraudWarning and pre-validates dates/ranges locally.

S6-BUG-01 CLAIMANT-15: the claimant claim projection (src/modules/claims/projection.mjs CLAIM_FIELDS) has no status history, so the status page cannot date steps the claim passed between polls (reported->validating->triaged->assigned happen within ~2 s). Please add statusHistory [{status, at}] to the claimant-safe projection. Client now records observed stage times per device as a fallback.

S6-BUG-01 CLAIMANT-16: POST /intake/sessions accepts any policyNumber; the only check is the holder 404 later. Please consider a non-oracle validation at start (format per tenant config, e.g. config.policyNumberPattern exposed in /config/public). Client now rejects implausible numbers (fewer than 5 digits) and names the policy in the holder-failure message.

Supervisor reassignment (ADJUSTER-14): POST /claims/{id}/routing override is refused (409) for in_review and pending_info claims (rules ROUTABLE = triaged|assigned|fast_tracked), so a supervisor cannot reassign most demo claims. Please allow an override that only changes adjusterId/queue on in_review/pending_info claims (no status change). The adjuster UI shows the override form when allowed and explains otherwise. Also: timer citations and routing reason phrases are English-only server text (ADJUSTER-21).
